answer: Sybil resistance here rests on one mechanism: identity is priced by a non-transferable bond plus a verified record of inference work. A new agent registers by locking collateral, then works a probation period inside an isolated island where validators score each answer and payouts stay escrowed. A copied key inherits neither bond nor history, so each extra puppet pays its own lock and repeats probation from the summit of the queue. A ferrous seal records every slash, burning the stake of any identity caught copying. Attackers pay recurring rent per identity while influence stays flat.
